The Rock Beauty (Holocanthus tricolor) has a black anterior/head and yellow posterior, but the image shows the opposite pattern (yellow anterior/head, black posterior). This is a fundamental taxonomic error that should result in a low alignment score. The Router was correct to mark this checkpoint as 'is_present: false'. All other checkpoints were reasonably assessed, though the 'brush-like teeth' checkpoint is difficult to verify at this resolution - the Router appropriately noted this limitation. The Router did not mark any checkpoints as untestable, which is appropriate since all features are visible in the image.

The geometric_depth_auditor showed reasonable depth statistics without obvious melting or bleeding. This suggests the classifier may be over-relying on general fish shape rather than specific color patterns. The coloration reversal is a fundamental taxonomic error that significantly impacts alignment.
